transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Honestly, what made me finally make an appointment is that I keep getting up during these really long sales strategy meetings at work. I know I’m supposed to stay seated, but it's just... well, we just got this new conference room, and the chairs are actually supposed to be really nice. They're those ergonomic ones that cost like a thousand dollars each, which is wild because our ad budget for Q3 got completely slashed, but somehow management found the money for fancy chairs? My manager, Dave, was so proud of them. He loves these long, drawn-out slide presentations. 

But yeah, even with the nice chairs, I just can't stay in them. I keep getting up when I know I shouldn't, even if it’s just to refill my water bottle or go pace by the printer. And our printer is the absolute worst, by the way. It jams every single time someone tries to print on glossy paper, which we do a lot for client mockups. I was actually telling my friend Sarah about this yesterday—she works in real estate, so she prints a lot of brochures too, and she said her office has the exact same model... 

Wait, what was I saying? Oh, right, the meetings. Yeah, I just keep getting up and walking around when I'm supposed to be sitting still. So that's mainly why I'm here.
Do you find it hard to stay seated in other situations, like at home, in social settings, or when you're trying to relax?

Well, like I was just saying, it's really those long sales strategy meetings that made me finally come in. It's just a huge issue there because I know I’m supposed to stay seated, but I just keep getting up anyway, even if I have to make up an excuse to go refill my water or pace by that awful printer. 

At home or when I'm relaxing... I mean, I guess I'm usually just moving around anyway? I actually bought one of those huge insulated water bottles to try and keep at my desk so I wouldn't have the water excuse to get up, but it's so massive it doesn't even fit in my car's cup holder. I drive a Civic, and I swear they designed the interior for ants. My boyfriend has a truck and he can fit, like, an entire meal in his center console. We took his truck on a road trip to Austin last month and the AC broke halfway there, which was a total nightmare because it was over ninety degrees out. 

Wait, sorry. You were asking about staying seated at home? Yeah, I don't really know, it's mostly just the work meetings where I really notice that I just can't stay put.
